claim: A game frame running with interrupts off that overruns one video frame misses the interrupt it spans, so that limiter cycle takes one extra interrupt; track the raster and credit missed interrupts.
limit: Times are simulated and optimistic: wait states are modelled by an 8/6.5 factor.

evidence.text: Game frame runs in the IM2 handler at one update per 3 interrupts; a frame over 20 ms makes that cycle take 4 (a 1/50 s hitch): 8% and 17% of frames over 20 ms in two recordings, 32.5% before recovery in one build; recovery needs over 60 ms to hitch.
The redraw after a lost life went from 124 frames to 57-58 on JNext; the update then starts at the next interrupt so it moves in 20 ms steps.
